verdict.oneLiner: Credentials take minutes, but reading mail uses restricted scopes: OAuth verification (about 6 weeks) plus an annual third-party security assessment.

approvalWait.note: Google's estimates, not guaranteed: brand verification 2–3 business days, sensitive scopes about 10 business days, restricted scopes about 6 weeks. The security assessment is extra and yearly.

prerequisites.label: A domain you own, verified in Search Console
prerequisites.detail: Every domain in the consent screen's Authorized domains must be verified by a project owner or editor in Google Search Console.

prerequisites.label: A real homepage and privacy policy on that domain
prerequisites.detail: The homepage must describe the app and link the privacy policy; it can't be only a login page. The same privacy policy must be linked from the consent screen.

prerequisites.label: A demo video (sensitive/restricted scopes)
prerequisites.detail: Must show the end-to-end flow including the full consent screen in English with the same scopes.

prerequisites.label: Budget and time for a security assessment (restricted scopes)
prerequisites.detail: Needed yearly from a Google-empanelled assessor if you store or transmit restricted-scope data. Google charges nothing; assessor pricing is between you and them.

steps.title: Create a Cloud project and OAuth client
steps.body: Get OAuth 2.0 credentials for a web application from the Google API Console.

steps.title: Configure the consent screen
steps.body: Add app name, homepage, privacy policy and authorized domains. Scopes are categorised as non-sensitive, sensitive or restricted automatically when you add them.
steps.agentCanHelp: Drafts the scope justifications Google asks for.

steps.title: Pick the narrowest Gmail scopes
steps.body: gmail.labels is non-sensitive, gmail.send is sensitive, and gmail.readonly, gmail.modify, gmail.compose, gmail.metadata and full mail access are restricted. You must explain why narrower scopes won't work.
steps.agentCanHelp: Maps your features to the least-privileged scopes.

steps.title: Implement OAuth with incremental scopes
steps.body: Request scopes when they're needed rather than up front. Keep requested scopes identical to the consent screen to avoid the unverified-app screen.
steps.agentCanHelp: Writes the auth flow and token handling.

steps.title: Develop in Testing status
steps.body: Apps in development don't need verification, but in Testing status refresh tokens expire after 7 days unless you only ask for name, email and profile.

steps.title: Submit for verification
steps.body: Brand verification takes about 2–3 business days, sensitive scopes about 10 business days, restricted scopes about 6 weeks. Google says these aren't guaranteed.

steps.title: Pass the security assessment (restricted scopes)
steps.body: Complete an annual assessment from a Google-empanelled assessor, and re-verify restricted-scope access every year.

scopes.name: gmail.send
scopes.note: Sensitive: verification with justification and demo video.

scopes.name: gmail.readonly
scopes.note: Restricted: verification plus security assessment if you store or transmit the data.

scopes.name: gmail.metadata
scopes.note: Restricted, even though it excludes message bodies.

nuances.title: Unverified apps are capped at 100 new users, forever
nuances.body: Unverified apps using sensitive or restricted scopes are limited to 100 new users over the project's lifetime. The cap can't be reset.

nuances.title: Testing status: refresh tokens die after 7 days
nuances.body: Expect users to re-consent weekly while the app is in Testing.

nuances.title: 100 refresh tokens per account per client
nuances.body: Issuing more silently invalidates the oldest. Refresh tokens also stop working after six months unused.

nuances.title: Internal apps are exempt
nuances.body: Apps used only inside one Cloud Organization don't need verification.

nuances.title: Restricted access is re-verified annually
nuances.body: Plan for the assessment and re-verification every year, not just once.

blockers.title: Users see an 'unverified app' warning
blockers.symptom: A warning appears before the consent screen.
blockers.fix: Make requested scopes match the consent screen and complete verification.

blockers.title: Verification rejected for scope justification
blockers.symptom: Google asks why narrower scopes won't work.
blockers.fix: Request only the narrowest scopes and explain, per scope, why a narrower one is insufficient.

blockers.title: Authorized domain not verified
blockers.fix: Have a project owner or editor verify each domain in Google Search Console.

blockers.title: Users must reconnect every week
blockers.fix: Your project is in Testing status; publish it (and verify) for long-lived refresh tokens.
